text: {"assertions":["A NaN feature bug was discovered in the ml/features/encoder.py file on 2026-01-13.","The bug only appeared after a rolling restart of the fleet was performed.","The bug could be reproduced by encoding a batch containing a sparse column.","Two write operations in ml/features/encoder.py that were not wrapped in a transaction were identified as the root cause.","The bug manifested as a not-a-number value appearing in one output column.","The fix involved wrapping both write operations in a single transaction.","The fix was implemented in PR #2651 on branch fix/nan-feature-1.","Memory usage stabilized at 388 MB after the fix instead of climbing past 1 GB."]}
